# `backends` package: architecture note excerpt

Full note: `knowledge/architecture/backends.md`; update it in the same change (skill `notes`).

## Responsibility

- Generate assistant text for a rendered snapshot and return it as a `GenerationRecord`; optionally reuse prompt-prefix state and compute model embeddings.

## Invariants

- The API, LM Studio and transformers backends refuse audio parts with `ValueError`; the mock backend hashes text only (D02 - Audio backend (`knowledge/issues/D02 - Audio backend.md`)).
- Greedy transformers outputs are identical with the prefix cache on and off, and their logprobs agree within 1e-4; no prompt token is processed twice.
- A backend injected into `ExplainRunner` is reused across calls and closed by the runner; otherwise one backend is built and closed per `explain()`.

## Known issues

- D04 - KV prefix cache changes float16 greedy outputs (`knowledge/issues/D04 - KV prefix cache changes float16 greedy outputs.md`): float16 greedy outputs can differ with the prefix cache on.
- Fixed: C06, C08, C15 (Fixed issues (`knowledge/issues/Fixed issues.md`)).
